description: This file defines configuration settings for an API service, including environment variable parsing, a Settings dataclass, and a function to load settings from environment variables.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: Immutable dataclass holding runtime configuration for the API service, including network, URLs, metrics, and CORS settings.

methods.name: _parse_bool
methods.description: Parses a string environment variable into a boolean value with a default fallback.

methods.name: _parse_int
methods.description: Parses a string environment variable into an integer with a default fallback.

methods.name: _parse_json
methods.description: Parses a JSON string from an environment variable, returning a default on failure.

methods.name: get_settings
methods.description: Loads and returns the API service configuration settings from environment variables, with defaults and overrides.
